reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V1 (KS-recalibrated with per-segment yaw-gyro bias removed using straight-regime mean of pred-meas), reusing platform L from agent's code/parameters.py and applying per-platform (Mach-E and F-150) on each canonical Ford segment.
notes: Agent declared V1 their best variant ('the only improving step'; 'all of which is attributable to V1: per-segment yaw-gyro bias removal'). V1 originally ran only on Mach-E; we apply the same per-segment bias-cancellation recipe (with each platform's canonical L) to all 545 canonical Ford segments. Bias is fitted on each segment's full straight-regime samples (no v-filter), matching the agent's triage.v1_ks_recalibrated implementation; RMSE is then pooled over rows with v_mps > 2.0.
